Create Channel.description: Creates a channel that routes matching requests through OpenHIM to an upstream system, e.g. a FHIR server.

Register Client.description: Registers a client system (e.g. an EMR or OpenFn itself) that can call OpenHIM channels.

Rerun Failed Transactions.description: Creates a rerun task for a list of transactions, e.g. after an upstream outage is fixed.

Get Failed Transactions.description: Fetches transactions that failed, e.g. to alert on or rerun them.

Get Transaction.description: Fetches a single transaction by its id.
Get Transaction.code:
// Get one transaction by id.
getTransactions({ transactionId: $.data.transactionId });

List Channels.description: Lists all channels configured in OpenHIM, or one channel by id.

List Clients.description: Lists all registered client systems, or one client by id.

Get Rerun Tasks.description: Lists rerun tasks and their progress.
